headline: Brent Holds Near $92 as Looming Supply Surplus Collides With Geopolitical Risks
summary: Brent crude traded narrowly around $92.18 per barrel as agency forecasts pointing to an impending oil surplus offset ongoing Middle East conflict and stalled diplomacy. Prices remain down from October highs above $110.
why: Crude oil is a primary driver of global transportation costs and headline inflation, heavily influencing central bank interest rate trajectories.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Crude prices are caught between bearish agency surplus forecasts and supply risk premiums from Middle East instability.
